mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the slowing industrial sector weighs on the broader economy.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spikes > 0.5pp m-o-m but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, it signals a healthy demand environment that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between the 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, predicts an economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y spread < 50 bps but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the employment-to-population ratio (proxied by EMRATIO) rises by more than 1 percentage point over 6 months, it signals a tightening labor market that will put upward pressure on wages and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: EMRATIO rises > 1pp in 6 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by PCE) grow by more than 4% year-over-year while the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) remains below 2%, it signals a healthy demand environment without excessive inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PCE y-o-y change > 4% AND CPIAUCSL y-o-y change < 2%
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 60, indicating a strong expansion in manufacturing activity, and the capacity utilization rate (TCU) is below 80%, it predicts a positive output gap and strong S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger condition met but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.
